title: Data Engineer
description_html:
About the role

We move payment data for thousands of small merchants.

What you'll do

  • Build batch and streaming data pipelines with Spark and Airflow
  • Model warehouse tables with dbt
  • Keep our AWS infrastructure tidy

What you bring

  • Python and SQL
  • Docker
  • Git

Nice to have

  • Kafka
  • Terraform

Pay and benefits

  • Salary: $110,000–$130,000 CAD per year
  • Four weeks of vacation and a yearly learning budget
